title: Calls, texts & voice notes
goal: Answer and end calls naturally, cope with a bad line, say you'll call back, text and send voice notes, and say what you've just done, already done, are still doing or haven't done yet.
intro:
Half of your Marathi will happen on the phone: a quick **हां, बोल** when a friend calls, **ऐकू येतंय का?** on a bad line in the local train, **पोहोचल्यावर मेसेज कर** to someone heading home late, and a dozen WhatsApp groups that never sleep.

Phone Marathi is full of English — कॉल, मेसेज, रिप्लाय, लोकेशन — glued in with Marathi verbs like **करणे** and **पाठवणे**. The grammar is how to chain actions with **-ऊन** ('do X and then Y') and **-ल्यावर** ('once X is done'), and the little time words **आत्ताच** (just), **आधीच / केव्हाच** (already), **अजून** (still, not yet).

grammar.title: Do X and then Y: -ऊन and -ल्यावर
grammar.body:
**-ऊन 'having done'.** Add **-ऊन** to the stem to join two actions by the same person: **कर → करून**, **बस → बसून**, **बघ → बघून**, **जेव → जेवून**, **जा → जाऊन**, **ये → येऊन**, **घे → घेऊन**, **खा → खाऊन**. Only the last verb carries tense and person:

घरी **जाऊन** फोन करतो 'I'll go home and (then) call you'.
मेसेज **वाचून** रिप्लाय कर 'read the message and reply'.

It also gives the cause: बातमी **ऐकून** आनंद झाला 'I was happy to hear the news'.

**-ल्यावर 'after, once'.** Take the past form (पोहोचला, आला, झाला, संपला), drop the ending and add **-ल्यावर**: **पोहोचल्यावर** 'once (you) get there', **आल्यावर** 'when (you) come', **जेवल्यावर** 'after eating'. Here the two actions can have **different** people: तू आल्यावर आपण जेवूया 'let's eat once you get here'.

The trap: with -ऊन both actions must belong to the **same** person. For 'when **you** arrive, **I'll** call', use -ल्यावर: तू पोहोचल्यावर मी फोन करेन.

grammar.title: Just, already, still, not yet: आत्ताच, आधीच, केव्हाच, अजून
grammar.body:
**Just:** **आत्ताच** 'just now' (also **नुकतंच** 'just, recently'): मी आत्ताच पोहोचलो 'I've just arrived'.

**Already:** **आधीच** 'already, beforehand': मी आधीच सांगितलं होतं 'I'd already told you'. **केव्हाच** 'ages ago' is stronger: तो केव्हाच निघाला 'he left ages ago'.

**Still:** **अजून** or **अजूनही** + present: मी अजून ऑफिसमध्येच आहे 'I'm still at the office'.

**Not yet:** **अजून** + the past + **नाही**: त्याने अजून रिप्लाय केला नाही 'he hasn't replied yet'. The one-word answer is **अजून नाही**.

**'Have done':** for something done that still matters now, spoken Marathi adds a contracted आहे to the past, agreeing as the past does: पाठवला आहे → **पाठवलाय** (m object: मेसेज), **पाठवलंय** (n: लोकेशन), **पाठवलीये** (f: व्हॉइस नोट). In the negative, just use the past: आला **नाही** 'hasn't come'.

The trap: **अजून** also means 'more' (अजून चहा? 'more tea?'). With a negative it is 'yet'; with a present it is 'still'.

examples.en: I've just sent you a message.
You haven't got there yet? (to a man)

dialogue.setting: Thane, near Mumbai. Nikhil has come by local train to his friend Priya's birthday dinner and can't find her building. The line is bad.

culture: On the phone, Marathi speakers answer **हॅलो** and, if they know you, go straight to **हां, बोल** 'yes, tell me' — there's no 'how are you' first. With older people or someone you call तुम्ही, say who you are: **नमस्कार काका, मी निखिल बोलतोय** 'hello uncle, it's Nikhil'. Calls end abruptly by English standards: **चल, ठेवतो** or **ठेवू?** 'shall I hang up?' and that's it. The **missed call** is a whole language — 'I'm downstairs', 'call me back', 'I've arrived' — and **मिस्ड कॉल दे** is a normal request. Every family has a WhatsApp group where relatives **forward** good-morning images and doubtful news, and voice notes are hugely popular with people who'd rather talk than type in Devanagari. Many people type Marathi in Roman letters ('kuthe ahes?', 'nighalo'), so learn to read that too. In Mumbai's local trains and tunnels, **रेंज नाहीये** is the most-said sentence of the day.

tip.title: हॅलो… हां, बोल… चल, ठेवतो
tip.body:
- Answer **हॅलो**; to a friend **हां, बोल** 'yes, go ahead'; to an unknown number **कोण बोलतंय?**
- Say who you are: **मी आदित्य बोलतोय** (man) / **मी प्रिया बोलतेय** (woman).
- End with **चल, ठेवतो / ठेवते** 'OK, I'll hang up'.
- **फोन उचलणे** 'to pick up'; **फोन लागत नाहीये** 'I can't get through'.

tip.title: ऐकू येणे — can you hear?
tip.body:
- On the phone 'hear' is **ऐकू येणे**, with -ला: **मला ऐकू येत नाहीये** 'I can't hear'.
- Or: **आवाज येत नाहीये** 'the voice isn't coming'.
- **नाहीये** is spoken नाही आहे 'isn't (right now)'.
- **कट होणे** 'to drop', **कट करणे** 'to hang up on someone'.

tip.title: -ऊन and -ल्यावर: do X, then Y
tip.body:
- **-ऊन** 'having done': **जाऊन, येऊन, बघून, करून, जेवून**. Same person does both: घरी **जाऊन** फोन करतो.
- **-ल्यावर** 'once, after': **पोहोचल्यावर, आल्यावर, संपल्यावर**. The people can differ: तू आल्यावर आपण जेवूया.
- Only the last verb shows tense.

tip.title: English word + करणे
tip.body:
- Phone words come from English and take **करणे**: मेसेज **कर**, रिप्लाय **कर**, फॉरवर्ड **कर**, व्हिडिओ कॉल **कर**.
- In the past with मी / त्याने / तिने, the verb agrees with the thing: मी मेसेज **केला** (m), आईने मेसेज फॉरवर्ड **केले** (pl).
- 'On the group' = **ग्रुपवर**.

tip.title: आत्ताच · आधीच / केव्हाच · अजून
tip.body:
- **आत्ताच** 'just now': मी आत्ताच पोहोचलो.
- **आधीच** 'already'; **केव्हाच** 'ages ago'.
- **अजून / अजूनही** + present = 'still': मी अजून ऑफिसमध्येच आहे.
- **अजून** + past + **नाही** = 'not yet': त्याने अजून रिप्लाय केला नाही.
tip.pattern: अजून + present = still · अजून + past + नाही = not yet

sentences.native: मी आत्ताच घरी पोहोचलो.
sentences.roman: mī āttāts gharī pohotslo.
sentences.en: I've just got home. (man)

sentences.native: तो केव्हाच झोपला, फोन स्विच ऑफ आहे.
sentences.roman: to kevhāts dzhoplā, fon svich ôf āhe.
sentences.en: He went to sleep ages ago, his phone's switched off.

sentences.native: मी अजूनही ऑफिसमध्येच आहे.
sentences.roman: mī adzūnhī ôfismadhyets āhe.
sentences.en: I'm still at the office.

sentences.native: त्याने अजून मेसेज बघितला नाही.
sentences.roman: tyāne adzūn mesej baghitlā nāhī.
sentences.en: He hasn't seen the message yet.

sentences.native: माझी बॅटरी संपली, चार्जर आहे का?
sentences.roman: mājhī bæṭrī samplī, chārjar āhe kā?
sentences.en: My battery's dead, have you got a charger?

sentences.native: मी आधीच सगळ्यांना सांगितलंय.
sentences.roman: mī ādhīts sagḷyānnā sāṅgitlaṃy.
sentences.en: I've already told everyone.

sentences.native: फोन चार्जरला लावलाय, थोड्या वेळाने कॉल करतो.
sentences.roman: fon chārjarlā lāvlāy, thoḍyā veḷāne kôl karto.
sentences.en: My phone's on charge, I'll call in a bit.

sentences.native: तुझा फोन केव्हापासून स्विच ऑफ आहे!
sentences.roman: tudzhā fon kevhāpāsūn svich ôf āhe!
sentences.en: Your phone's been switched off for ages!

sentences.native: अजून पोहोचली नाहीस?
sentences.roman: adzūn pohotslī nāhīs?
sentences.en: You haven't got there yet? (to a woman)

sentences.native: तिने आत्ताच व्हॉइस नोट पाठवली.
sentences.roman: tine āttāts vhôis noṭ pāṭhavlī.
sentences.en: She just sent a voice note.
